children: Xiaomi Corporation Class B (HKEX:1810) climbed after strong SkyNomad SUV demand and 40k+ September deliveries, rolled up its Europe car launch to H2 2027 with German dealer MOUs, and refreshed phones—flagship Xiaomi 18 Pro chipset boost, new Redmi models with long OS support and powerful specs.
Xiaomi Class B 1810 Stock Soars On SkyNomad Orders
: Xiaomi Class B (1810) jumped up to 9.2% in Hong Kong after reports of 70,000+ nonrefundable SkyNomad SUV orders in its first month; September deliveries topped 40,000, including 10,000 SkyNomads.
Xiaomi Class B 1810 EU Launch Delayed Later
: Xiaomi Corp Class B (1810) moved up its European auto launch to H2 2027 and signed non-binding MOUs with eight German dealer groups to aid the rollout.
Xiaomi Class B 1810 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6
: Xiaomi Class B (1810): Xiaomi 18 Pro to use Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 for international and Indian markets, aiming to boost graphics, camera and AI performance.
Xiaomi Class B 1810 Redmi Note 17 Pro 5G
: Xiaomi Class B (1810) launched Redmi Note 17 Pro 5G with HyperOS 3 (Android 16). Company pledged four major OS upgrades and six years of security patches, support through 2032.
Xiaomi Class B 1810 Redmi Turbo 5 Details
: Xiaomi Class B (1810): Redmi Turbo 5 gaming phone with Dimensity 8500 Ultra, 7,540mAh battery + 100W fast charge, 120Hz AMOLED, large cooling and 256GB storage; 256GB model ~Rs.47,000 in India.
: Xiaomi Corp Class B (1810): rear camera: 50MP OIS main + 8MP ultrawide. Daylight photos good; low-light weak. Video limited to 1080p30—no 4K or 60fps.
